name: Wufoo
tagline: Wufoo's solo core is compact: build a online forms tool with a schema-based form editor, public share link, validation, response table, CSV export, and webhook. A competent builder can reach a useful personal version in one sitting, while the paid product mainly wins on delivery, integrations, compliance.
